The '''Unwashed''' were the common citizenry of the [[Anointed People]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee]], that they called Masterhome. The Unwashed formed the lower social class of sturdy hard workers. The [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Godling]]s kept them uneducated, so that, unlike the Godlings, the Unwashed did not know about, or care for, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life in other planets. The Unwashed had simple interests, including their business, most of them [[Farm/Legends|farming]], any local business and the upcoming holidays. They also liked [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] and drinking, particularly in three-day parties.<ref name="Godking" />

The Unwashed favored [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]] when available, and they commonly carried their personal belongings plus one [[Club/Legends|club]] that could do little permanent harm to any other hard-boned Unwashed. The Unwashed commonly worked in a town or a farm for an individual Godling. Under the reign of [[Godking]] [[Trisstan]], that Godling annually took his subjects to a mock war against any neighboring Godling. This was a highly awaited time for the Unwashed.<ref name="Godking" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Godking]] [[Trisstan]], supreme monarch of Abonshee, hired one Unwashed to secretly infiltrate in the rooms of visiting [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] and steal their equipment. Trisstan wanted to test the abilities of his guests, particularly their alertness. He promised the Unwashed some [[Gold/Legends|gold]] [[Currency/Legends|coins]] even if he got caught.<ref name="Godking" />
